verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is an open-source, client-side 3D rendering and game engine distributed as npm packages. It is not a hosted data service, so choosing a storage region or data residency is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows a first-party hosted storage offering with region selection; the Playground's sharing feature is mentioned, but no storage-location controls are documented for it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
